strategies.name: trend_reversal_to_higher_timeframe_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: Use the higher timeframe (4H/1H) trend bias first, then on the 15-minute or 5-minute chart wait for a pullback trend to stop making lower lows, form a higher low, and then break above the most recent lower high to confirm the lower timeframe has turned bullish. Enter on that bullish break in the HTF
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss under the invalidation low / higher-low area that should not break if the reversal is valid. Target the next higher-timeframe high (such as the 1H high), with the option to continue holding if the broader 4H trend is still pushing higher.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to stop making lower lows and then break above the lower high
variants.target_note: target the 1H high; can hold further with the 4H trend
variants.transcript_quote: all you're doing is waiting for price to go back bullish on that 15minute time frame and putting your stop loss under that level where you don't want

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches one core strategy: align with higher-timeframe trend and enter when the lower timeframe shifts bullish; the 15-minute and 5-minute examples are compatible variants of the same entry/exit skeleton. The final 1-minute scalp mention is not promoted because its exit/management is not taught concretely.
